informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SC-28 (Protection of Information at Rest)
NIST PF 1.0 Core (January 2020): PR.DS-P1 (verified in NIST-Privacy-Framework-V1.0-Core.xlsx row 90)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 PR.DS-01 (privacy-tailored text)
implementation_examples: Apply encryption, access controls, and integrity protections to stored personal data per the organisation's risk strategy
Apply cryptographic protections to backup copies of personal data
Restrict access to personal-data stores to authorised personnel and processes
assessment_objectives: Determine whether stored personal data is identified and classified
Determine whether cryptographic protections (confidentiality, integrity) are applied commensurate with classification
Determine whether access to data-at-rest stores is logged and reviewed
